name: Soulblade Ascendant
source:
Soulblade Ascendant (Visual Novel) is a Fantasy Visual Novel Game based on my upcoming game Soulblade Ascendant which is a 3D Story based hack and slash game. This game is also follow the story of Cassian, a village boy journey to becoming a king once he founds out that he is from the Royal Family.  

The Game have 3 Episodes with a great storyline, avaliable for free to play for WebGL, PC and Android. 

The game is made with Unity 2021.03.45f2, Tools used for visual novel is Fungus and Characters are made with Character creator 2D
